verdict.rationale: Dagster+ alerts notify users of critical events in a deployment, and capacity-metric alert policies are documented. The UI surfaces asset check results with metadata, and context.log provides in-code logging. Syncs from Airbyte, Fivetran and dlt can be orchestrated as assets, though the evidence does not show alert channels or per-sync row counts, and alerting is documented only for the paid Dagster+ tier. Missing for 10: documented Slack/email/webhook alert channels, per-sync row-count metrics, explicit run-status/log viewing docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
